name: Protopasta Static Dissipative Carbon Fiber PLA @base
filament_notes:
Static Dissipative Carbon Fiber PLA. TDS: 210-230C, 60C plate, up to 12 mm3/s, 0.4 mm or larger nozzle. Material Data Table: 220C up to 6 mm3/s, 240C up to 12 mm3/s, 55C plate.
Abrasive: hard steel nozzle and gears recommended; replace PTFE tubing more often. Use Magigoo or glue stick and purge extra on filament changes.
